subject: [AMBER] CPPTRAJ returns 'Warning: Box center specified but no box information'

messages.author: Ikuo KURISAKI
messages.body:
Dear Ambers,
Thank you for kind supports everytime.
I have a question in running cpptraj.
Although both my prmtop file and restrt file (ASCII format) has box
information,
*  In prmtop file
%FLAG BOX_DIMENSIONS
%FORMAT(5E16.8)
9.00000000E+01  1.40914087E+02  1.41640791E+02  1.83700518E+02
*  In restrt file
135.2730000 135.9800000 176.3510000  90.0000000  90.0000000  90.0000000
I got 'Warning: Box center specified but no box information'
and 'center' command did not work.
Is this due to version of AmberTools (I'm using AmberTools 18)?
Or should I consider other problem with regard to files of mine?
For example, size of system (my system has 330,000 atoms in one
configuration.)
I'm most happy if you give me any advices, suggestions.
Best regards,
Kurisaki
===========================================

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
It would help if you gave your entire input file you are using for
cpptraj. You can also send me your topology and restart off list and I
can try to reproduce the issue.
-Dan
